name: Flodder
description: The misadventures of the anti-social Flodder family living in a upscale suburban neighborhood.

videos.title: Flodder
videos.overview: A rather a-social family, gets a chance to live in an upper-class neighbourhood. As they are not accepted by the snobs living there, they get in all sorts of trouble.

videos.title: Flooder Does Manhattan
videos.overview: The mayor of Sunny Dale see a chance to get rid of the Flodder family: They send the asocial bunch for an international exchange to New York. There they get confused with a Russian delegation of medical doctors while the street worker Werner who accompanies them becomes imprisoned.

videos.title: Flodder 3 (a.k.a. Flodder Forever)
videos.overview: Back from their trip abroad, the family must meet the people of the neighborhood while preparing for the 25th anniversary of Zonnedael. Ma falls in love with a bum that is not exactly what he seems to be.

videos.title: Korte metten
videos.overview: The neighborhood wants the Flodders to go and tries to catch them red handed selling illegal whiskey.

videos.title: Soldaat Kees
videos.overview: Kees has to join the army. Johnny needs him for a poker game and therefore tries everything he can think of to keep Kees from having to go.

videos.title: Verkiezingen
videos.overview: A local candidate for a spot in the town council discovers his only chance of winning the election, is by promising to throw the Flodders out of Zonnnedael.

videos.title: Goud geld
videos.overview: Johnny tries to earn a lot of money by producing a number of tapes of telephone sex lines with Daughter Kees and Son Kees. It goes wrong when one of the tapes is accidentally swapped with a tape of neighbor Neuteboom which he had made for the funeral of a colleague.

videos.title: Inbraak alarm
videos.overview: A burglar is very active in the neighborhood and the Flodders are the usual suspects.

videos.title: Blauw bloed
videos.overview: The Flodders are about to inherit a fortune from an old aunt, but only if Ma Flodder displays good manners can she achieve nobility and get the cash.

videos.title: Latin Lover (1)
videos.overview: Johnny agrees to hide an Italian for a night for 5000 guilders. However, Ma shouldn't find out because Johnny doesn't think she'd agree.

videos.title: Latin Lover (2)
videos.overview: Ma Flodder has grown extremely fond of Vitorio. They are even planning on getting married. Johnny decides it is time for drastic measures.

videos.title: De verjaardag
videos.overview: The queen decides to visit Zonnedael on the national holiday of Queens Day. The neighbourhood as wel as the local government try to get rid of the Flodders for this day so the family can't ruin the festivities. However, the Flodders have no plans on leaving since it's Ma's birthday.

videos.title: Goed gedrag
videos.overview: During a drive, son Kees falls out of the car and hits his head on the pavement, causing him amnesia. He turns into a well-mannered young man who does chores for the neighborhood. This to the frustration of Johnny and the rest of the family. They will try everything to get the old Kees back. Meanwhile, Sjakie is really fond of the well-mannered Kees and decides to introduce two important government people to him.

videos.title: Succes verzekerd
videos.overview: After Whiskey molests the postman again, Sjakie wants the family to insure themselves for these kind of 'accidents'. When Johnny learns more about insurances, he finds a couple of ways to make some extra money.

videos.title: De vondeling
videos.overview: A baby gets left on the Flodders' doorstep.

videos.title: De mooiste dag van je leven
videos.overview: When Johnny forgets about Mothers day, he quickly needs a present he can give to Ma. He decides to give her the gift of a wedding; her oldest son is getting married. An enthusiastic Ma starts planning the wedding right away. However, Johnny doesn't even have a bride yet. And that is of course something he can't let Ma know.

videos.title: De dubbelgangster
videos.overview: A couple of neighbours find a woman that looks exactly like Ma Flodder. They decide to hire her so this lookalike can cause some serious damage in Zonnedael, causing the police to arrest the real Ma.

videos.title: In de ring
videos.overview: Johnny and Kees get into a fight with Vince, one of the members of the tennis club of Zonnedael, at a local video store. Vince challenges Johnny into a real boxing duel. Johnny ofcourse accepts. But then Vince turns out to be a boxing champion. And even worse, after Johnny injures himself, Kees has to take his place in the big fight...

videos.title: De afrekening
videos.overview: One of Ma's old lovers is being released out of prison. This guy named Danny always said to take revenge on her because she betrailed him. Johnny and Kees make sure that no one gets into their villa by defending their house with everything they got.

videos.title: Lopende zaken
videos.overview: In order to make up for a spelling error on merchandise, Johnnie enters Kees in a marathon and resorts to the lowest tricks so she can win.

videos.title: Doodziek
videos.overview: When Ma visits her doctor, she is being told she has only a couple of months to live. Johnny takes drastic measures but is this really necessary?

videos.title: De penvriend
videos.overview: Daughter Kees has a pen pal in prison. When Johnny and son Kees find out, the pen pal turns out to be 'Cold Arie', a notorious criminal who is being released on short notice. Things get even worse when daughter Kees admits to Johnny that she promised Arie she will marry him as soon as he gets out of prison

videos.title: Onder hypnose
videos.overview: Son Kees orders a hypnose course in order to get in touch with women.

videos.title: Op heterdaad
videos.overview: When criminality gets out of hand in Zonnedael, the neighbourhood is setting up a neighbourhood watch. Son Kees is the first to apply voluntarily.

videos.title: Kees verliefd
videos.overview: Kees falls in love with a police officer causing outrage from the rest of the family and Johhnies buddies.

videos.title: Familie Klikspaan
videos.overview: Johnnie is forced to help catch an international crime syndicate. For their own safety, the family must leave their house. They return to their home in complete disguise. The neighbors think a new family moved into the Flodder-home and they are very relieved. The Flodders find that their new identities gives them a few advantages too!

videos.title: Ontvoerd
videos.overview: Toet gets kidnapped, and learns a valuable lesson about family.

videos.title: Contact gestoord
videos.overview: When Ma appears to be lonely, daughter Kees suggests to put in an anonymous contact add for her to meet someone. When Johnny, Kees and Kees arrange a date for her with someone who applied, they do not know this person is in fact Sjakie...

videos.title: Zalig uiteinde
videos.overview: When a F16 fighter pilot loses his bomb, it falls right into the Flodder's swimming pool. When son Kees finds it, he assumes it's part of the fireworks that Kareltje should deliver because of New Years Eve. Kees starts carrying it around the house not knowing he is causing severe danger to his family. Meanwhile, Sjakie comes along to show his new car to the Flodders.

videos.title: Klepto ma
videos.overview: All over Zonnedael things get stolen. Ma is the first suspect. When the whole family gets arrested, Sjakie comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Blufpoker
videos.overview: Johnny loses his precious Chevrolet in a poker game. He goes all out to win it back.

videos.title: Op eigen benen
videos.overview: Johnny's friend L.J. hires Johnny and son Kees to get back a couple of stolen diamonds from the pimp Enrico. What they don't know is that at the same time Hennie hires daughter Kees for the exact same job.

videos.title: De promotie
videos.overview: Sjakie is worried about his job assessment at town hall. Ma tries to calm him down with her self-brewed whiskey. When Sjakie tries to drive home after, he accidentilly listens to a assertiveness training on the car radio. This results in a total new Sjakie who immediately gets a big promotion.

videos.title: De gave
videos.overview: Mysterious events result in people thinking son Kees has a special gift. Within no time the front yard of the Flodders is filled with crippled, handicapped and other sick people who come to Kees as a last resort.

videos.title: De hondlanger
videos.overview: A usual day of the life of the Flodder family, seen through the eyes of the family dog Whiskey.

videos.title: Computerkoorts
videos.overview: Henkie uses his hacking skills to his and the rest of the family's advantage.

videos.title: Van de wereld
videos.overview: Son Kees is acting very strange. It even looks if he's from a totally different planet.

videos.title: Laatste eer
videos.overview: Opa dies, and Johhny and Kees use him for some schemes in order to pay for a proper funeral.

videos.title: Heerlijk avondje
videos.overview: Johnny gets tricked by Kareltje to take in an expensive race horse for one night. When the horse isn't being picked up the next day, the Flodders need to get rid of the giant animal in their living room. The upcoming Sinterklaas holiday gives Johnny an idea.

videos.title: Tatoeage
videos.overview: Daughter Kees has a new bikini. The only problem is that it won't cover an old tattoo. After she gets rid of the tattoo, the ex-boy friend who put it there shows up because the tattoo contained a secret message.

videos.title: Vlees
videos.overview: The Flodders are having a barbecue, but obtaining proper meat is much harder than it seems.

videos.title: Vormfouten
videos.overview: The Flodders get nervous because the government will be checking all people who collect unemployment benefits to see if there isn't been done any undeclared work. The only problem is that no one knows who the person is who will be doing this check.

videos.title: Laatste wens
videos.overview: Son Kees has suicidal intentions because of a girl that is totally out of his league. Johnny decides to help him but when he sees the girl, he can't repress some self-interest.

videos.title: Lijmpoging
videos.overview: Ma wants to redecorate by putting up new wallpaper in the living room. Toet and Henkie find a few boxes with nice paper in the garage. What they don't know is that Johnny is conserving some valuable papers for the big criminal Robbie in that same garage.

videos.title: Gijzeling
videos.overview: A bank robber on the run, takes hostage of Ma and a couple of neighbours in the mobile shop of Van Putte. Sjakie is being appointed as a negotiator.

videos.title: Vriezen en dooien
videos.overview: Gus, an acquaintance of Johnny and Kees, is dying and wants to be frozen for thirty years. Johnny offers to keep him in his fridge, for a small fee of course.

videos.title: Gluren bij de buren
videos.overview: A secret agent is being installed at the Flodder's home to spy at one of the neighbours.

videos.title: Videogeweld
videos.overview: Who is responsible for all the agressive children in Zonnedael? The neighbourhood accuses the Flodder family but Sjakie thinks the new video rental store has something to do with it because of all the fighting films they offer.

videos.title: Vindersloon
videos.overview: Henkie and Toet discover a new way of earning money; kidnapping animals and then collecting the reward when they bring them back.

videos.title: 1 april
videos.overview: Johnny and son Kees find out that it's not a good idea to do business with dangerous criminals on April Fools day.

videos.title: Schijnvertoning
videos.overview: Johnny marries a Polish woman so she has the right papers to work in the Netherlands. The woman, however, doesn't seem to understand the marriage is fake, just as Kees, who thinks his brother is really getting hooked.

videos.title: Huisarrest
videos.overview: Thanks to his recent criminal activity, Kees is forced to spend the day within a 10 feet radius of the house while the rest of the Flodders are going to the beach.

videos.title: Gifwolk
videos.overview: When a nearby factory loses a cloud of toxic gas, the whole area of Zonnedael is being evacuated. The Flodders however, are the only ones that don't have any clue of what's going on.

videos.title: Rijles
videos.overview: Kees is tired of always relying on Johnnie for transportation and decides to take driving lessons.

videos.title: Vrijdag de 13e
videos.overview: Friday the 13th, brings a lot of bad luck to the Flodders, who are trying to go to a Harco Sorbato concert.

videos.title: Bergplaats
videos.overview: Much ado about a safe in the floor of the house after Ma has decided everybody should give Ma their money because the family has to become more thrifty.

videos.title: Vossejacht
videos.overview: Hennie has an art expert interested in an icon he stole. However, the art expert wants a certificate that proves the icon is real. Since Hennie doesn't know anything about art he didn't steal the certificate and asks Johnny and Kees to steal it.

videos.title: Egotrip
videos.overview: When Johnny and son Kees get electrocuted by accident, they find themselves trapped in each other's body.

videos.title: Huisbezoek
videos.overview: Strange things happen when Ma Flodder is home alone.

videos.title: Sleutelfiguur
videos.overview: The family is planning a trip to Aunt Agaath. Johnny however, forgot that he also planned a drag race at the same day so he is doing everything to get out of the family visit.

videos.title: Medium raar
videos.overview: After a séance son Kees acts very strange. Very strange indeed.

videos.title: Breekpunt
videos.overview: Ma suffers from a terrible tooth ache. When Johnny meets a so called dentist at the coffee house, he thinks the problem can be solved on short notice. Meanwhile, daughter Kees thinks she has met the love of her life.

videos.title: Bijwerkingen
videos.overview: Toet and Henkie need money to buy a video game and therefore let Opa take part in a medical experiment.

videos.title: Inzet
videos.overview: Johnny trusts son Kees with his money so Kees can give it to Hennie to bet on the horse races. However, before Kees meets Hennie he already has lost the money. Kees is trying everything to make some money before Johnny gets back.

videos.title: Quarantaine
videos.overview: Kees might have a very dangerous virus and the whole family (including Sjakie, who happened to be visiting the family) have to stay indoors for the next twenty-four hours.
